360:t_018:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「In place of thanks, I'll remove your enemy for you.」

360:t_018:11.en:
$$アスカ$$
「That guy...! Is he looking right at us!?」

360:t_019:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「You're not... hurt, are you, $$アスカ$$?」

360:t_019:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Brat $$シンジ$$! Who said you could go and shield me on your own!?」

360:t_019:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't stand it... anymore... seeing anyone get hurt...!」

360:t_019:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「...This is what the Lilin are. You would probably despise them as Wingless, though.」

360:t_019:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How foolish. I cannot understand it.」

360:t_019:11.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't let you use the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ for your ambitions!!」

360:t_019:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...There's no need to be so impatient, winged dog and Wingless. The day of the harvest is still far off.」

360:t_019:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Until then, keep struggling. With every bit of that paltry strength of yours.」

360:t_020:0.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That bastard! After all that big talk, he ran away!」

360:t_020:1.en:
$$モロイ$$
「But he talked as if he were waiting for his chance.」

360:t_020:2.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「A-Are we going to be okay!? If the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ gets taken from us, won't the world's balance go haywire again...!」

360:t_020:3.en:
$$カヲル$$
「You needn't worry about that. The balance of the world is being maintained.」

360:t_020:7.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Ugh, seriously! Is this any time to be doing that? Think!」

360:t_020:9.en:
$$アスカ$$
「The enemy's still out there, Brat $$シンジ$$! If you're going to talk big, hurry up and take care of them!」

360:t_020:13.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this, $$シンジ$$! You have the power to protect someone!」

360:t_020:15.en:
$$カヲル$$
「You can do it. I'm here to help you with that.」

360:t_020:17.en:
$$カヲル$$
(And, $$シンジ$$... I will protect you...)

360:t_021:0.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Have all the enemies been dealt with?」

360:t_021:1.en:
$$アレク$$
「$$ギルボア$$ reports that the cleanup of the surrounding area is finished as well.」

360:t_021:2.en:
$$フラスト$$
「I'd heard about it, but $c has been fighting monsters like those too, huh...」

360:t_021:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Good work, $$ガランシェール$$ crew. Come in and dock with the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ too.」

360:t_021:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$ and the others have gotten a little of their old rhythm back.」

360:t_021:7.en:
$n
「I hope this turns things around for the better.」

360:t_021:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The problem is $$ミカゲ$$, then...」

360:t_021:9.en:
$$アルト$$
(What is this harvest day he was talking about...? And do $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ have something to do with it too...?)

360:t_022:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn...! Don't think this is all I'm made of!」

360:t_023:1.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「He doesn't even know anymore what he's fighting for...」

360:t_024:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're persistent, $$カミーユ$$! Stop bothering me!」

360:t_024:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Say that after you stop coming after me!」

360:t_024:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't fight over personal feelings, $$ギュネイ$$! Is that all you amount to!?」

360:t_024:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you won't stop fighting, I have no choice but to meet you head-on!」

360:t_025:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it already, $$ギュネイ$$! Come with us!」

360:t_025:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...I've got something I have to do! Until I've done it, I can't go to where you are!」

360:t_025:2.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「You! Don't you understand how much you hurt $$クェス$$ when you behave so selfishly!」

360:t_025:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No, I'm going to say it! If you keep making $$クェス$$ suffer, I'll defeat you myself!」

360:t_025:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That boy...! What does he think he's doing!?」

360:t_025:7.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That's all right, isn't it, $$クェス$$?」

360:t_025:9.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn... DAMN IT!! What the hell am I doing!?」

360:t_026:0.en:
$$クェス$$
「Stop it already, $$ギュネイ$$! Come with us!」

360:t_026:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...I've got something I have to do! Until I've done it, I can't go to where you are!」

360:t_026:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「Hardheaded fool! Is surpassing the Colonel and $$カミーユ$$ really that important!?」

360:t_026:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then I'll show you! That you're no match for those two!」

360:t_026:6.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn... DAMN IT!! What the hell am I doing!?」

360:t_027:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! Don't take the wrong path forward!」

360:t_027:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're one to talk, Colonel!」

360:t_027:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「...True enough... It seems I cannot stop you with words.」

360:t_027:3.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Then what will you do?」

360:t_027:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then I'll act like an adult and teach the young how powerless they are!」

360:t_027:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Interesting! Then I'll get rid of the old man by force!」

360:t_028:0.en:
$$フラスト$$
「Look at that, even the $$ガランシェール$$ can do it if it tries.」
